## History

Kenneth was a figure in Leslie's past who tragically died when he fell off a large load of hay as it was being pulled into the barn. [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) later reflected on how the painful history surrounding her past contributed to long-held bitter emotions and envy toward [Anne](../character/anne.md). By sharing these difficult memories and opening up to [Anne](../character/anne.md) in the garden, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) cleared the air, allowing the two women to form a deeper and lasting friendship.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P16](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P0](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P4](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P6](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P7](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P8](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0008), +21 more_
